title: Unit 4: Dilemmas: First & Second Conditional
objective: Mampu membicarakan situasi hipotetis, mengungkapkan keinginan, meminta maaf dan menerima permintaan maaf menggunakan first, second, dan third conditional dengan tepat

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas penggunaan conditional sentences untuk membicarakan berbagai situasi. First conditional digunakan untuk situasi nyata dan kemungkinan yang bisa terjadi di masa depan. Second conditional untuk situasi hipotetis atau tidak mungkin terjadi di masa sekarang/depan. Third conditional untuk membicarakan situasi masa lalu yang tidak terjadi dan membayangkan hasil yang berbeda.
rules: First Conditional: If + present simple, will + verb (future clause). Contoh: If you always tell the truth, people will trust you.
Second Conditional: If + past simple, would + verb. Contoh: What would you do if you found £100 in a cash machine?
Third Conditional: If + past perfect, would(n't) have + past participle. Contoh: If Billy had looked up, he would have seen a young lady.
Wish + if only: Gunakan 'I wish / if only + past tense' untuk menyatakan keinginan situasi sekarang berbeda. Contoh: I wish I could kill Lord Voldemort.
Time conjunctions: unless, if, until, when, as soon as. Contoh: I won't tell him anything unless he asks.

commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula salah menggunakan 'will' setelah 'if' dalam first conditional. Padahal setelah 'if' harus menggunakan present simple, bukan will.
commonTrap.wrong: If you will always tell the truth, people will trust you.
commonTrap.correct: If you always tell the truth, people will trust you.

vocab.meaning: dilema; situasi sulit yang mengharuskan memilih di antara dua atau lebih alternatif
vocab.collocation: I've got a dilemma. The other day I cheated in a test.
First, say sorry for cheating and explain why you did it.

vocab.meaning: lolos dari hukuman; tidak ketahuan melakukan kesalahan
vocab.collocation: You can't get away with cheating forever.
I'd say I was staying at a friend's house and hide the truth from them.
If you always tell the truth, people will trust you.

vocab.meaning: mengakui kesalahan; bertanggung jawab atas perbuatan
vocab.collocation: I'd own up and say it was me.
Do you ever reconsider decisions you have made?
How good are you at making your mind up about small things?

dialogue.context: Dan dan Ana sedang membicarakan dilema yang dihadapi Dan tentang mencontek dalam ujian dan bagaimana cara terbaik mengatasinya

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: I've got a dilemma. The other day I cheated in a test. I copied from Ben.
lines.translation: Aku punya dilema. Beberapa hari lalu aku mencontek dalam ujian. Aku menyontek dari Ben.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: Well, I thought I could get away with it, but now the teacher wants to know who copied who.
lines.translation: Yah, aku pikir aku bisa lolos, tapi sekarang gurunya ingin tahu siapa yang menyontek siapa.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: You should own up to it and say it was you.
lines.translation: Kamu harus mengakuinya dan katakan itu kamu.

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: I know, but it's too difficult to tell the truth.
lines.translation: Aku tahu, tapi terlalu sulit untuk mengatakan yang sebenarnya.

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: But you can't tell the truth now! What about poor Ben? What were you thinking?
lines.translation: Tapi kamu tidak bisa katakan yang sebenarnya sekarang! Bagaimana dengan Ben yang malang? Kamu mikir apa?

lines.speaker: Dan
lines.text: You're right, of course. It's just so difficult to do the right thing sometimes.
lines.translation: Kamu benar, tentu saja. Cuma kadang begitu sulit untuk melakukan hal yang benar.

speakingLab.context: Latihan simulasi percakapan dengan tutor tentang dilema moral yang mungkin dihadapi dalam kehidupan sehari-hari

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about dilemmas. Let me ask you: what would you do if you found a wallet full of money on the street?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would try to find the owner or take it to the police station.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's very honest of you! Now, imagine you noticed your best friend cheating in an important exam. Would you tell the teacher?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's difficult. I think I would talk to my friend first and ask them to tell the truth themselves.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good thinking! One more question: if you could change one decision you made in the past, what would it be?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: If I had studied harder last year, I would have gotten better grades.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent use of the third conditional! Remember, we all make mistakes, but learning from them is what matters most.

quiz.question: What _____ you do if you found £100 in a cash machine?
quiz.explanation: Gunakan 'would' karena ini adalah second conditional (situasi hipotetis). Pola: If + past simple, would + verb.

quiz.question: If you always _____ the truth, people will trust you.
quiz.explanation: Gunakan present simple 'tell' setelah 'if' dalam first conditional. Jangan gunakan 'will' di klausa 'if'.

quiz.question: I wish I _____ older.
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'I wish' untuk menyatakan keinginan situasi sekarang berbeda, gunakan past tense. 'I wish I was/were older' berarti saya ingin lebih tua.

quiz.question: If Billy _____ up, he _____ a young lady on her way to work.
quiz.explanation: Ini adalah third conditional (situasi masa lalu yang tidak terjadi). Pola: If + past perfect, would have + past participle.

quiz.question: I won't tell him anything _____ he asks.
quiz.explanation: 'Unless' berarti 'kecuali jika' atau 'jika tidak'. Kalimat ini berarti 'Saya tidak akan memberitahunya apa-apa kecuali dia bertanya.'

quiz.question: If only I _____ an interesting book with me on this long journey!
quiz.explanation: Gunakan past tense setelah 'if only' untuk menyatakan keinginan situasi sekarang berbeda. 'If only I had' = 'Andai saja saya punya'.
